technical-summary: Reserve failed collective cleanup in the existing cross-DSO rendezvous slot before publishing rank buffers. Poison and wake peers on post-publication failure, then dispose of failed rank allocations on their original devices after the owning engine's ranks and device streams drain. Verify exact-once retirement, unrelated-owner isolation and TP group reuse with the real bridge and CPU fault injection.
user-summary-candidate: Radiance releases failed tensor-parallel collective buffers after peers have finished using them, so the next engine can reuse that group.
